table.name: Project
table.customFieldJoin: left join $.projectcustomfields pcf on t.projectcustomfieldsid = pcf.id

sqlquery.from: (select distinct pj.id as projectid, pj.name as name, pj.number as projectnumber, pj.description as description, pj.startdate as startdate, pj.enddate as enddate, pj.timespent as timespent, pj.creationtime as creationtime, pj.percent as percent, pj.id as projectid, mu.id as muserid, wk.name as workstreamname, wk.id as workstreamid, (mu.firstname ||' '|| mu.lastname) as employeefullname, (ma.firstname ||' '|| ma.lastname) as managerfullname, (bma.firstname ||' '|| bma.lastname) as backmanagername, cl.name as clientname, ma.id as managerid, tm.leaderid, (ld.firstname ||' '|| ld.lastname) as leaderfullname, pjem.isdeleted as pjemisdeleted, st.name as statusname, pj.isdeleted as isprojectDeleted ,pj.projectcustomfieldsid from "$".project pj left join "$".projectemployee pjem on pj.id = pjem.projectid left join "$".teamemployee tmem on pjem.employeedepartmentid=tmem.id left join "$".myuser mu on tmem.employeeid = mu.id left join "$".employee em on em.id = tmem.employeeid left join "$".team tm on tm.id = tmem.teamid left join "reference" st on st.id= pj.statusid left join "$".myuser ma on ma.id = pj.managerid left join "$".myuser bma on bma.id = pj.backup_managerid left join "$".myuser ld on ld.id = tm.leaderid left join "$".workstream wk on (pj.id = wk.projectid and wk.deleted is not true ) left join "$".crmaccount cl on pj.clientid = cl.id ) t
